product: Bezuclastinib, an oral selective KIT D816V and exon-17 inhibitor. Three indications: GIST in combination with sunitinib (PEAK), non-advanced systemic mastocytosis (SUMMIT) and advanced SM (APEX). No product revenue yet; FY2027 consensus revenue is 292.8M dollars (stockanalysis.com, 2026-09-27).
demand: Pre-revenue, so no sales mix yet exists. Growth, when it starts, is volume-driven: a launch ramp into existing treated GIST and SM populations, with pricing undisclosed. Consensus models revenue rising from 5.99M dollars FY2026 to 292.8M dollars FY2027 (stockanalysis.com, 2026-09-27), i.e. entirely volume and launch ramp, not price.
pricing_power: There is no product margin yet: pre-revenue, Q2 2026 operating expenses 102.6M dollars and net loss 96.4M dollars (SEC EX-99.1, 2026-08-10). A future margin collapse would come from gross-to-net rebates, avapritinib price competition in SM, Hovione manufacturing cost overruns, or a narrowed label. Near-term risk is cash burn and dilution, not gross margin.
competition: Not found for the mechanism. No approved low-cost Chinese KIT D816V inhibitor competes in SM or GIST. Generic imatinib and sunitinib are cheap but are the drugs bezuclastinib adds to or beats, not substitutes. Branded avapritinib is the alternative but not low-cost (Cogent IR, EHA data 2026-06-12).
market_strategy: CEO Andrew Robbins, 2026-08-10 (SEC EX-99.1): three NDAs filed after positive pivotal trials; potential FDA approval of bezuclastinib in GIST (PDUFA 2026-11-30) and NonAdvSM (PDUFA 2026-12-30); the company is well prepared to launch bezuclastinib; SUMMIT avapritinib-switch preliminary results expected by end of 2026; INDs for CGT1815 and CGT1145.
bull: Three FDA NDA acceptances in 2026 with PDUFA dates 2026-11-30, 2026-12-30, 2027-06-29; PEAK Phase 3 GIST mPFS 16.5 vs 9.2 months, HR 0.50; Hovione supply deal signed 2026-09-01; cash runway into late 2028.
bear: Pre-revenue: Q2 2026 net loss 96.4M dollars, opex 102.6M dollars, 400M dollar ATM shelf filed 2026-08-10; price down 12.0 percent over 21 sessions; no revenue or margin data in engine record; binary FDA outcomes.
falsifier: A complete response letter or delay to the 2026-11-30 GIST PDUFA (or the 2026-12-30 NonAdvSM PDUFA) would prove the bull case wrong.

web_bottleneck: The company bottleneck is FDA review timing and launch execution: PDUFA 2026-11-30 GIST, 2026-12-30 NonAdvSM, 2027-06-29 AdvSM (Cogent IR). At the same time it relieves the treatment bottleneck in non-advanced SM (avapritinib tolerability) and second-line GIST (imatinib and sunitinib resistance).
web_who_benefits_next: Hovione, contracted 2026-09-01 to manufacture bezuclastinib tablets and spray-dried dispersion (SEC 8-K). Second order: sunitinib suppliers (bezuclastinib is dosed with sunitinib), KIT-mutation testing labs, specialty pharmacies and the rare-disease GIST and SM patient population. Cogent added 59 new launch staff (2026-08-10).
web_who_loses: Blueprint Medicines: its avapritinib (Ayvakit) is the incumbent in advanced and non-advanced systemic mastocytosis that Cogent SUMMIT avapritinib-switch cohort directly targets. In GIST, Deciphera ripretinib (Qinlock) and generic sunitinib monotherapy would lose share to the bezuclastinib plus sunitinib combination.

web_did_they_deliver: Yes. 2026-05-28 FDA accepted the GIST NDA with Priority Review; 2026-06-30 the AdvSM NDA was submitted; 2026-09-15 FDA accepted the AdvSM NDA with PDUFA 2027-06-29; the commercial field team was fully hired by 2026-08-10; cash runway guided into late 2028. No dated management promise was found missed (Cogent IR; SEC filings).
